# Board Deck - Eng Section Draft Oct

Eng section for the 2026-10-21 board meeting. Due to Aleks by 2026-10-17. Prep doc is Board Meeting Oct 21 - Prep (Notion); my talk track is Board Meeting Oct 21 - Talking Points. This file is slide text only. Five slides max. Last time was nine and Dana Whitaker said, kindly, that four would have been plenty.

Several things resolve between now and the meeting (go/no-go 10/16, VP Eng decision 10/20, Pillar remediation plan 10/15), so every slide has a TK where the answer lands. Rewrite the weekend before.

---

## Slide 1: Eng at a glance

- 31 engineers (of 64), up from TK in May
- Sep: 151k MAU / 101k MTU / $5.3M sub ARR
- Shipped since August board update:
  - ACH pipeline cut over Aug 18. Zero missed NACHA cutoffs since
  - KYC on Alloy, migration done Aug 29, $120k/yr COGS saved
  - Investing beta live Sep 8 to ~5k users
- Not shipped: investing GA (TK, see slide 2), card (moved to Q1 2027, slide 5)

## Slide 2: Investing GA

- Beta: 5% of MTU since Sep 8. Pillar money-movement approval in hand ($2,500/user daily cap for first 90 days)
- Go/no-go #1 (Sep 29): no-go. Three blockers:
  - Position reconciliation fix (0.4% of positions off by fractional shares after a corporate action). TK status
  - Disclosures final review. Done, signed Oct 7
  - Android parity, 2 screens. TK status
- Go/no-go #2 Oct 16. GA target Oct 20. TK outcome
- [if no-go: say the new date and the one reason. Don't list five reasons.]

## Slide 3: Reliability and the Sep 26 incident

- Sep 26: duplicate round-up debits. 1,412 users, ~$9 avg, detected in 47 min, reversed same day, Pillar notified <24h
- Root cause: missing idempotency key on the round-up sweep (old Rails/Sidekiq system, not the new ACH pipeline)
- Remediation:
  - Idempotency keys on all money-moving jobs (due Oct 23)
  - Round-up sweep onto new pipeline (Q4)
  - Written remediation plan to Pillar (due Oct 15). TK: Pillar response
- Framing: April's fix worked; September was in the part we hadn't migrated. True, and also a lesson about scoping fixes to the class of problem.

## Slide 4: Org and hiring

- VP Eng: two finalists (Grace Liu, Tomas Reyes). Decision by Oct 20. TK name, start date
- Plan post-close: 12 eng hires in 9 months
  - 2 payments, 2 iOS (incl. senior), 1 Android, 2 data/ML, 1 SRE, 1 security, 2 growth, 1 EM
- Problem: offer-accept rate 55%. Senior iOS comp bands below market. Ask: approve band refresh post-close
- Bus factor on payments is still Marcus + Devon. Hiring plan addresses it; VP Eng takes ops load off both of us

## Slide 5: SOC 2, card, what's next

- SOC 2 Type I clean (Jun 30). Type II window Jul 1 to Dec 31
- Three gaps from Sep 10 readiness review: access reviews (TK % at meeting), vendor risk (2 of 4, rest due Oct 24), MDM (96%, 100% due Oct 17)
- Card issuing with Lithic: soft launch moved to Q1 2027 to protect investing GA and the Series B. Aleks and I agreed Sep 30
- Q4 priorities: investing GA, sweep migration, VP Eng onboarding, SOC 2 window clean. See Q4 Engineering Plan

---

## Notes to self
- Series B is Aleks's section. Mine only touches it via the data room and Elena's diligence call (Oct 14). One line on slide 1 at most.
- Risk: the deck says "GA Oct 20" and the meeting is Oct 21. If we no-go on Oct 16 the slide must say so plainly. Board finds out from us, not from the product update.
- Open question: ask the board for anything? Candidate: support for the band refresh. Jordan's call whether that's a board ask or an exec decision.
- Decision: no architecture slide this time. Elena gets the architecture. The board gets outcomes.
